feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 828 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: CDL School Payback Calculator
entry.summary: Free CDL school payback calculator: tuition, fees, weeks out of work, weekly miles and pay per mile become the cost to get in, the monthly gain over your current job, months to pay it back and company-paid training versus paying yourself. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Estimate Maker — Free Quote & Estimate Generator, No Signup, Works Offline
entry.summary: Free estimate and quote generator: good-better-best options, optional add-ons, tax, deposit, valid-until date, print to PDF, win-rate and follow-up tracking, one-click convert to invoice. No account, no watermark, works offline.

entry.title: Expense Tracker for Freelancers — Free, Private, Schedule C Categories
entry.summary: Free expense tracker for freelancers and the self-employed: log expenses, import a bank CSV, see deductible totals by Schedule C line and by quarterly payment period, flag missing receipts. No account, works offline, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Freelance Dashboard — Overdue Invoices, Unbilled Time, Profit and What to Do Next
entry.summary: Free freelancer dashboard that runs in your browser: see overdue invoices, unbilled hours, your estimate pipeline, year-to-date profit and tax set-aside, plus a ranked list of what to do next. No account, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Freelancer Tax Pack — Free 2026 Schedule C, SE Tax and Quarterly Estimate
entry.summary: Free year-end tax pack for freelancers: pulls your invoices, expenses and mileage from this browser, then shows Schedule C net profit, self-employment tax, a 2026 federal estimate, quarterly payments still due and the 1099-NEC list. No account, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Proposal Maker — Free Client Proposal Generator, No Signup, Works Offline
entry.summary: Free proposal generator for freelancers, consultants and small agencies: scope with included and excluded lists, phases with dates, fixed, good-better-best, hourly-with-cap or retainer pricing, deposit and milestones, change-order wording, acceptance block, print to PDF. No account, no watermark, works offline.

entry.title: Time Tracker — Free Billable Hours Timer, No Signup, Invoices From Your Hours
entry.summary: Free time tracker for freelancers and contractors: start a timer or add hours by hand, set a rate per project, round up the way you bill, see unbilled money by client, and turn tracked hours into an Invoice Maker draft. No account, no limit, works offline.

entry.title: Wedding Officiant Fee Calculator
entry.summary: Free wedding officiant fee calculator: your fee, ceremonies a year, consultation, script writing, rehearsal, driving and yearly costs become real hourly pay, yearly net, break-even ceremonies and the fee that reaches your target. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: Wholesale Line Sheet Maker — Free Line Sheet and Wholesale Pricing Tool
entry.summary: Free wholesale line sheet maker for makers and small brands: set wholesale prices from MSRP or cost, check your margin and the retailer's margin, simulate boutique orders with tier discounts and minimums, and print a priced line sheet. No signup, works offline, data stays on your device.

entry.title: ABA Authorization Tracker
entry.summary: Free ABA authorization tracker: paste your authorizations and see which units run out early, which expire unused, and when each reauthorization is due. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.title: App Store & Google Play Listing Checker — Keyword Field, Character Limits and Rejection Risks
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your App Store or Google Play listing text and check it before you submit — character limits, wasted keyword-field characters, repeated words, promotional claims in the name, placeholder text and keyword stuffing. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded. A zero-dependency CLI lints a fastlane metadata folder in CI.

Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Campground Site Profit Calculator
entry.summary: Free profit calculator for campgrounds and RV parks: sites, months open, occupancy, nightly rate, booking commission, turnover labour and fixed costs become yearly profit, break-even occupancy and the nightly rate you need. Private, runs in your browser.

entry.summary: Free 13-week cash flow forecast that assumes invoices arrive late: paste your invoices and bills, and 2,000 simulated outcomes show the chance you run short, the cushion that would cover it and which invoice or bill to fix first. Private, runs in your browser.
